_notes: Green chromis school parameters (P2.5), used by components/School and components/lib/school.brs. Coordinates are scene pixels of the fish anchor (the rig mirror_center), times in seconds, speeds in px/s, accelerations in px/s^2, alignRate in 1/s. The leader is a virtual agent that is never drawn; it steers against the ellipses padded by leaderPad and the lane inset by leaderInset so the school detours as a group. minDist is a hard guard checked at every sub-step; sepRadius is the soft separation range. boundRadius is the documented bound on any member's distance from the school centroid, asserted by tests/unit/school_test.brs. The lane and ellipses are copied from config/brain.json for SchoolDemoScene; ReefTank replaces lane, ellipses and count from config/scene.json population (P2.7).
